000651.one: Çin'in büyük klima üreticisi; hendek dar, ölçütü geçti. Ancak satış ve kâr geriliyor, üçüncü çeyrek kârı %43,3 düştü.
000651.business: Gree, ev ve iş yeri kliması üretir ve kendi markasıyla satar. 2025'te 170,45 milyar yuan gelirin 133,06 milyar yuanı, yani yaklaşık %78'i, çoğu klima olan tüketici cihazlarından geldi. Para, markalı ürünün bayi ağı üzerinden satışından kazanılır.
000651.moat_text: Hendek dar. Marka ve bayi ağı gerçek: dokuz aylık brüt kâr marjı %27,0, net kâr marjı %13,7 ve reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yıldır %18'in üzerinde (2024'te %24,66). Ama üstünlük tek ürüne, klimaya bağlı ve şu an sınanıyor. Şirket fiyat indirmedi, ham madde pahalandı ve üçüncü çeyrek brüt marjı 5,6 puan düşerek %22,7'ye indi. Gelir 2024'teki 190,04 milyar yuandan 2025'te 170,45 milyar yuana geriledi. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı son 12 ayda %15,49'a düştü. Bu yüzden hendek geniş sayılmadı.
000651.mgmt: Şirketin hâkim ortağı yok. En büyük ortak, Hillhouse Capital bağlantılı Zhuhai Mingjun'dur (%16,11). Mingjun hisselerinin yaklaşık %87,6'sı rehinlidir ve Şubat 2026'da banka kredisi ödemek için 112 milyon hisseye kadar satış planı açıkladı. Yönetim kurulu başkanı Dong Mingzhu'nun payı %2,22'dir; halefi belli değil. Kârın büyük kısmı temettüye gidiyor: 2026 ara temettüsü 10 hisseye 10 yuan, toplam 5,55 milyar yuan. Genel kurul bir geri alım planını da onayladı. Net borç yok; şirket net nakittedir.
000651.latest: 26 Ekim 2026: Şirket dokuz aylık sonuçlarını açıkladı. Gelir %8,1 düşüşle 126,08 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı %19,5 düşüşle 17,27 milyar yuan oldu. Üçüncü çeyrekte gelir %8,0 düşüşle 36,68 milyar yuan, net kâr %43,3 düşüşle 4,00 milyar yuan. Faaliyet nakit akışı %47,4 azalarak 24,06 milyar yuana indi. Şirket düşüşü klima satışlarındaki gerilemeye, sektördeki stok eritmeye, rekabete ve yüksek ham madde fiyatlarına bağladı.

en.one: A large Chinese air conditioner maker; the moat is narrow and it meets the criterion. But sales and profit are falling; third-quarter profit dropped 43.3%.
en.business: Gree makes home and commercial air conditioners and sells them under its own brand. In 2025, 133.06 billion yuan of its 170.45 billion yuan revenue, about 78%, came from consumer appliances, mostly air conditioners. It earns money by selling branded products through a dealer network.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The brand and dealer network are real: nine-month gross margin is 27.0%, net margin 13.7%, and real return on equity has been above 18% for five years (24.66% in 2024). But the edge rests on one product, air conditioners, and is being tested now. The company did not cut prices, raw materials got dearer and third-quarter gross margin fell 5.6 points to 22.7%. Revenue fell from 190.04 billion yuan in 2024 to 170.45 billion yuan in 2025. Real return on equity dropped to 15.49% over the last twelve months. That is why the moat is not rated wide.
en.mgmt: The company has no controlling shareholder. The largest shareholder is Zhuhai Mingjun, linked to Hillhouse Capital (16.11%). About 87.6% of Mingjun's shares are pledged, and in February 2026 it announced a plan to sell up to 112 million shares to repay bank loans. Chairwoman Dong Mingzhu holds 2.22%; her successor is not known. Most of the profit goes to dividends: the 2026 interim dividend is 10 yuan per 10 shares, 5.55 billion yuan in total. The shareholders' meeting also approved a buyback plan. There is no net debt; the company holds net cash.
en.latest: 26 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue fell 8.1% to 126.08 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders fell 19.5% to 17.27 billion yuan. In the third quarter revenue fell 8.0% to 36.68 billion yuan and net profit fell 43.3% to 4.00 billion yuan. Operating cash flow fell 47.4% to 24.06 billion yuan. The company blamed lower air conditioner sales, industry destocking, competition and high raw material prices.
risks: Profit is falling: third-quarter net profit dropped 43.3% and real return on equity fell to 15.49% over the last twelve months; if the decline continues, the price criterion moves further away.
About 78% of revenue depends on air conditioners; home air conditioner sales in China fell 8.4% in nine months and 15.1% in the third quarter.
The company does not cut prices; it loses market share if rivals do, and margin if raw materials stay expensive.
Most of the largest shareholder's shares are pledged and it has a selling plan; this can put supply pressure on the stock.
Chairwoman Dong Mingzhu's successor is not known; a change of management carries uncertainty.

basis.tr: Formül yılda %4,3 büyüme veriyordu. En güncel veriler (net kâr, yıllık değişim): Ocak-Eylül 2026 %−20,3 (şirketin düzeltilmiş rakamı; açıklanan %−19,5); Temmuz-Eylül 2026 çeyreği %−44,3 (şirketin düzeltilmiş rakamı; açıklanan %−43,3). Düzeltme: Tek seferlik kalemler hariç net kâr: dokuz ayda 16,403 milyar yuan, üçüncü çeyrekte 3,696 milyar yuan; düşüş raporlananla aynı, tek seferlik kalem etkisi yok. En düşüğü, enflasyondan arındırılınca, %0,0 (sıfırın altı sıfır sayılır). Bu, formülün hızının yarısından az olduğu için ikisinin ortası alındı: %2,2.
basis.en: The formula gave growth of 4.3% a year. Latest figures (net profit, year on year): January-September 2026 −20.3% (the company's adjusted figure; reported −19.5%); July-September 2026 quarter −44.3% (the company's adjusted figure; reported −43.3%). Adjustment: Net profit excluding non-recurring items: 16.403 billion yuan in nine months, 3.696 billion in the third quarter; the fall matches the reported one, no one-off effect. The lowest, after inflation, is 0.0% (below zero counts as zero). Because this is less than half the formula's rate, the midpoint of the two was used: 2.2%.

basis.tr: Hesap son 12 ayın kârına dayanır. Bu kârın içindeki tek seferlik kazançlar: Şirketin 'olağan dışı' diye ayırdığı kalemlerin son 12 aydaki net tutarı (devlet destekleri ve finansal araçların değer artışı): son 12 ay kârının %5,2 kadarı. Net etki %5,2; kazanç bu kadar indirildi. Son 12 ayın kârı 0,95 ile çarpılarak kullanıldı.
basis.en: The calculation rests on the profit of the last 12 months. One-off gains inside that profit: Net total over the last 12 months of the items the company itself classes as non-recurring (government grants and fair-value gains): 5.2% of last-12-month profit. The net effect is 5.2%; earnings were lowered by that much. Last-12-month profit was used multiplied by 0.95.

000807.one: Yunnan'da temiz enerjiyle alüminyum üretiyor. Ürün emtiadır, kâr alüminyum fiyatına bağlıdır; hendek zayıf, ölçütü geçemedi.
000807.business: Yunnan Aluminium boksit çıkarır, alümina ve birincil alüminyum üretir, alaşım ve karbon ürünleri satar. 2024 yıllık raporuna göre 3,05 milyon ton alüminyum ve 1,40 milyon ton alümina kapasitesi var; 2024'te 2,94 milyon ton birincil alüminyum üretti. 2025 geliri 60,04 milyar yuan, net kârı 6,06 milyar yuandı.

Şirketin bir üstünlüğü var: 2026'nın ilk yarısında üretimde kullandığı elektriğin yaklaşık %88'i temiz enerjiydi ve Çin'de alüminyum kapasitesi yasal tavana yakın, yani yeni rakip girmesi zor. Ama ürün emtiadır; fiyatı şirket değil piyasa belirler. Kâr bunu gösteriyor: dokuz aylık net kâr %164,01 arttı, çünkü üçüncü çeyrekte alüminyum fiyatı %14,6 yükseldi, alümina %19,1 ucuzladı. Alüminanın yalnız %23'ünü kendi üretiyor. Bu yüzden şirket 3. suru geçemedi.
000807.mgmt: En büyük ortak devlet şirketi Chalco'dur (2024 sonunda %29,10); aynı gruptan Yunnan Metallurgical'ın payı %13,00'tür. İkisi de Chinalco grubunun denetimindedir. Kâr borç ödemeye ve temettüye gidiyor: borç oranı Eylül 2026 sonunda %15,27'ye indi, net nakit 21,18 milyar yuan. 2025 temettüsü kârın %40'ıydı (2,4 milyar yuan); 2026 ara temettüsü 10 hisseye 8,87 yuan, toplam 3,08 milyar yuan.
000807.latest: 29 Ekim 2026: Şirket dokuz aylık sonuçlarını açıkladı. Gelir %19,39 artışla 52,62 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı %164,01 artışla 11,61 milyar yuan oldu. en.one: It makes aluminium in Yunnan with clean energy. The product is a commodity and profit depends on the aluminium price; the moat is weak and it does not meet the criterion.
en.business: Yunnan Aluminium mines bauxite, produces alumina and primary aluminium, and sells alloys and carbon products. According to its 2024 annual report it has capacity for 3.05 million tonnes of aluminium and 1.40 million tonnes of alumina; it produced 2.94 million tonnes of primary aluminium in 2024. Revenue in 2025 was 60.04 billion yuan and net profit 6.06 billion yuan.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. The company has an edge: in the first half of 2026 about 88% of the electricity it used in production was clean energy, and aluminium capacity in China is close to the legal ceiling, so new rivals can hardly enter. But the product is a commodity; the market sets the price, not the company. Profit shows it: nine-month net profit rose 164.01% because in the third quarter the aluminium price rose 14.6% and alumina got 19.1% cheaper. Gross margin rose 16.65 points in a year to 32.04%. Real return on equity was 16.58% in 2024 and 35.95% over the last twelve months; that jump comes from price, not from pricing power. It makes only 23% of its own alumina. That is why the company did not pass the third wall.
en.mgmt: The largest shareholder is state-owned Chalco (29.10% at the end of 2024); Yunnan Metallurgical, from the same group, holds 13.00%. Both are controlled by the Chinalco group. Profit goes to debt repayment and dividends: the debt ratio fell to 15.27% at the end of September 2026 and net cash is 21.18 billion yuan. The 2025 dividend was 40% of profit (2.4 billion yuan); the 2026 interim dividend is 8.87 yuan per 10 shares, 3.08 billion yuan in total.
en.latest: 29 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 19.39% to 52.62 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 164.01% to 11.61 billion yuan. Third-quarter net profit was 3.93 billion yuan: 140.92% higher than a year earlier and 3.82% lower than the previous quarter. Operating cash flow rose 102.5% to 14.13 billion yuan.

002128.one: İç Moğolistan'da kömür çıkarır, elektrik ve alüminyum üretir. Maliyeti düşük ama sattığı her şey emtia; hendek ölçütünü geçemedi.
002128.business: Şirket linyit çıkarır, bu kömürle ve rüzgâr, güneş santralleriyle elektrik üretir, elektriği de alüminyum eritmekte kullanır. 2026'nın ilk yarısında gelirin %63,6'sı alüminyumdan, %24,18'i kömürden, %12,22'si elektrikten geldi. Kömür kapasitesi yılda 63 milyon ton, alüminyum kapasitesi yılda 1,6153 milyon ton.
002128.moat_text: Hendek zayıf. Üstünlük maliyette: kendi kömürü ve kendi elektriği alüminyumu ucuza üretmesini sağlıyor. 2026'nın ilk yarısında brüt kâr marjı kömürde %59,32, alüminyumda %39,87 oldu. Ama alüminyumun marjı bir yılda 16,26 puan arttı; bunu şirket değil alüminyum fiyatı belirledi. Kömür, elektrik ve alüminyumun fiyatını piyasa koyar, şirket koyamaz. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı 2025'te %14,97, son 12 ayda %17,89. Fiyat gücü kanıtlanmadığı için B puanı 1 kaldı ve şirket 3. suru geçemedi.
002128.mgmt: Şirket devletin elektrik grubu SPIC'e (State Power Investment Corporation) bağlıdır. Aracı kurum notuna göre Zhongdiantou Mengdong Energy %39,98, SPIC Inner Mongolia Energy %22,77 paya sahip. 2025 kârının yaklaşık %44'ü nakit temettü olarak dağıtıldı. Mayıs 2026'da grup içinden Baiyinhua Coal Power'ın tamamı hisse ve nakit karşılığı alındı; Temmuz 2026'da hisse başına 26,00 yuandan yaklaşık 4,5 milyar yuan sermaye toplandı. Alım ilişkili taraftan yapıldığı için D puanı 1.
002128.latest: 22 Ekim 2026: İlk dokuz ayda gelir 37,12 milyar yuan oldu, %19,63 arttı. Ana ortaklık net kârı 7,69 milyar yuan oldu, %43,57 arttı. Tek seferlikler hariç kâr 6,42 milyar yuan, artış %59,22. İşletme nakit akışı 13,73 milyar yuan. Kısa vadeli krediler yıl başına göre %81,69, uzun vadeli krediler %31,99 azaldı. en.one: It mines coal and makes power and aluminium in Inner Mongolia. Costs are low but everything it sells is a commodity; it did not meet the moat criterion.
en.business: The company mines lignite, generates power from that coal and from wind and solar plants, and uses the power to smelt aluminium. In the first half of 2026, 63.6% of revenue came from aluminium, 24.18% from coal and 12.22% from power. Coal capacity is 63 million tonnes a year and aluminium capacity is 1.6153 million tonnes a year.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. The edge is in cost: its own coal and its own power let it make aluminium cheaply. In the first half of 2026 gross margin was 59.32% in coal and 39.87% in aluminium. But the aluminium margin rose 16.26 points in one year; the aluminium price decided that, not the company. The market sets the price of coal, power and aluminium, the company cannot. Real return on equity was 14.97% in 2025 and 17.89% over the last 12 months. Pricing power is not proven, so the B score stays at 1 and the company did not pass the 3rd wall.
en.mgmt: The company belongs to the state power group SPIC (State Power Investment Corporation). According to a broker note, Zhongdiantou Mengdong Energy holds 39.98% and SPIC Inner Mongolia Energy holds 22.77%. About 44% of 2025 profit was paid as a cash dividend. In May 2026 it bought all of Baiyinhua Coal Power from within the group for shares and cash; in July 2026 it raised about 4.5 billion yuan of equity at 26.00 yuan a share. The purchase was from a related party, so the D score is 1.
en.latest: 22 October 2026: In the first nine months revenue was 37.12 billion yuan, up 19.63%. Net profit attributable to the parent was 7.69 billion yuan, up 43.57%. Profit excluding one-offs was 6.42 billion yuan, up 59.22%. Operating cash flow was 13.73 billion yuan. Short-term loans fell 81.69% and long-term loans fell 31.99% from the start of the year. Prior-year figures were restated because of the Baiyinhua purchase.

002668.one: Buzdolabı, derin dondurucu ve çamaşır makinesi üretir; çoğunu yurt dışına satar. Kalite surlarını geçti; 2026'da kâr geriledi ve fiyat güvenlik marjı için yetmiyor.
002668.business: Şirketin iki ana işletmesi var. Homa (Aoma) başka markalar için buzdolabı tasarlar ve üretir (ODM). Hefei Home Appliances ise TCL markalı buzdolabı ve çamaşır makinesi yapar. 2025'te gelir 18,53 milyar yuan oldu; bunun 14,405 milyar yuanı yurt dışından geldi. Küresel kapasite yılda 20 milyon adedin üzerinde.
002668.moat_text: Hendek dar. Kaynağı ölçek: şirketin açıklamasına göre Homa 17 yıldır Çin'in en büyük buzdolabı ihracatçısı, 18 yıldır da Avrupa'ya ihracatta birinci. Brüt kâr marjı 2025'te %25,2, 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında %23,0; fason üretici için yüksek. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı 2025'te %49,64, son 12 ayda %32,61. Zayıf yanı: ODM işinde marka müşterinindir, sipariş müşterinin kararına bağlıdır. Yüksek özsermaye kârlılığı kısmen ince özsermayeden geliyor; borçların varlıklara oranı %68,95. Kendi markasıyla yurt dışı satış hızlı büyüyor (ilk dokuz ayda %62,01) ama kalıcılığı henüz belli değil.
002668.mgmt: Hâkim ortak TCL Home Appliances Group'tur; 30 Eylül 2026'da payı %50,19. Bu şirketin tamamı TCL Industries Holdings'e aittir, nihai kontrol Li Dongsheng'dedir. 2025 kârından 10 hisseye 2,0379 yuan, toplam 220,9 milyon yuan nakit temettü önerildi; ana ortaklık kârı 1,123 milyar yuandı. Dağıtılmamış kâr 2025 sonunda artıya döndü ve 2026-2028 için üç yıllık pay sahibi getiri planı açıklandı. Kârın önemli kısmı azınlık paylarına gidiyor: 2025'te azınlık payı kârı 1,011 milyar yuan. Kâr Tayland'daki yeni fabrikalara da yatırılıyor. Temettü oranı düşük ve grup içi ilişkiler olduğu için D puanı 1.
002668.latest: 23 Ekim 2026: İlk dokuz ayda gelir 15,306 milyar yuan oldu, %6,69 arttı. Ana ortaklık net kârı 775 milyon yuan oldu, %20,67 azaldı. risks: Fiyat güvenlik marjı için yetmiyor: formül yılda %16,1 büyüme veriyordu, okumada bulunanlar yüzünden %8,1 alındı. Kâr 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında %20,67 geriledi; yuan değer kazanmaya devam ederse ihracat kârı daha da düşer.

Borçların varlıklara oranı %68,95; kârın yarıya yakını azınlık paylarına gidiyor, bu yüzden yüksek özsermaye kârlılığı olduğundan güçlü görünüyor.

en.one: It makes refrigerators, freezers and washing machines and sells most of them abroad. It passed the quality walls; profit fell in 2026 and the price leaves too little margin of safety.
en.business: The company has two main operating units. Homa (Aoma) designs and makes refrigerators for other brands (ODM). Hefei Home Appliances makes TCL-brand refrigerators and washing machines. In 2025 revenue was 18.53 billion yuan, of which 14.405 billion yuan came from abroad. Global capacity is above 20 million units a year.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. Its source is scale: according to the company, Homa has been China's largest refrigerator exporter for 17 years and first in exports to Europe for 18 years. Gross margin was 25.2% in 2025 and 23.0% in the first nine months of 2026; high for a contract maker. Real return on equity was 49.64% in 2025 and 32.61% over the last 12 months. The weak side: in ODM the brand belongs to the customer and orders depend on the customer's decision. The high return on equity comes partly from thin equity; liabilities are 68.95% of assets. Own-brand sales abroad are growing fast (62.01% in the first nine months) but their durability is not yet clear.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is TCL Home Appliances Group, with 50.19% on 30 September 2026. That company is wholly owned by TCL Industries Holdings, and ultimate control rests with Li Dongsheng. A cash dividend of 2.0379 yuan per 10 shares, 220.9 million yuan in total, was proposed from 2025 profit; profit attributable to the parent was 1.123 billion yuan. Retained earnings turned positive at the end of 2025 and a three-year shareholder return plan for 2026-2028 was announced. A large part of profit goes to minority interests: 1.011 billion yuan in 2025. Profit is also invested in new plants in Thailand. The payout is low and there are intra-group dealings, so the D score is 1.
en.latest: 23 October 2026: In the first nine months revenue was 15.306 billion yuan, up 6.69%. Net profit attributable to the parent was 775 million yuan, down 20.67%. According to the company, profit excluding currency effects was 943 million yuan, up 0.70%. In the third quarter revenue was 5.371 billion yuan (up 10.32%) and net profit 264 million yuan (down 22.15%). Overseas revenue rose 19.12%. A refrigerator plant in Thailand with capacity of 1.4 million units a year was completed in September 2026 and is in trial production.
risks: The price leaves too little margin of safety: the formula gave growth of 16.1% a year; because of what the reading found, 8.1% was used. Profit fell 20.67% in the first nine months of 2026; if the yuan keeps strengthening, export profit falls further.
In ODM the brand belongs to the customer; if large customers move orders to another maker, sales and margin fall together.
If raw material prices rise, the 23.0% gross margin narrows.
Most revenue comes from abroad, so tariffs and trade restrictions can reduce orders.
Liabilities are 68.95% of assets and close to half of profit goes to minority interests, so the high return on equity looks stronger than it is.
watch: Net profit attributable to the parent and profit excluding currency effects
Gross margin (25.2% in 2025, 23.0% in the first nine months)
Growth of own-brand sales abroad
Utilisation of the Thailand plants and the dividend payout

600710.one: Emtia ve makine ticareti yapar, gemi, jeneratör ve bahçe makinesi üretir. Çok kollu, ince marjlı bir iş; hendek ölçütünü geçemedi.
600710.business: Şirketin iki kolu var. Tedarik zinciri kolu emtia ticareti ve makine ithalat, ihracatı yapar. Sanayi kolu gemi inşa eder ve işletir, dizel jeneratör, bahçe makinesi, güneş paneli, çevre tesisi ve tekstil üretir. 2025'te gelir yaklaşık 117,8 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı yaklaşık 1,36 milyar yuan oldu; vergi öncesi kârın %76'sı sanayi kolundan geldi.
600710.moat_text: Hendek zayıf. İşin büyük kısmı ticarettir ve ticarette fiyatı piyasa koyar. 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında brüt kâr marjı %6,50, ana ortaklık net kâr marjı %1,13 oldu. Gemi inşada iş siparişle alınır ve döngüseldir; yine de eldeki 105 gemilik sipariş 2030'a kadar teslimat sağlıyor ve 2026'nın ilk yarısında gemi inşa brüt marjı %22,4 oldu. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı yüksek: 2025'te %22,42, son 12 ayda %21,43. Ama bu oran kalıcı bir fiyat gücünü göstermiyor: ilk dokuz ayda net kârın %61,5'i azınlık paylarına gitti. B puanı 1 olduğu için şirket 3. suru geçemedi.
600710.mgmt: Hâkim ortak devlete ait SINOMACH'tır (China National Machinery Industry Corporation), payı %41,60. 2025 kârından hisse başına 0,415 yuan, toplam yaklaşık 542,3 milyon yuan nakit temettü önerildi; bu, ana ortaklık kârının %40'ı. Kârın büyük bölümü bağlı şirketlerdeki azınlık ortaklara kalıyor. Bağlı şirket Lanke Gaoxin Temmuz 2026'da China Air Separation'ın %51'ini aldı.
600710.latest: 30 Eylül 2026: İlk dokuz ayda gelir 103,70 milyar yuan oldu, %17,3 arttı. Ana ortaklık net kârı 1,17 milyar yuan oldu, %5,2 arttı. Vergi öncesi kâr 3,98 milyar yuan, artış %15,6; fark, vergi oranının %17,5'ten %23,7'ye çıkmasından ve azınlık payının büyümesinden geldi. Üçüncü çeyrekte gelir 37,28 milyar yuan (%14,2 artış), net kâr 477 milyon yuan (%1,0 artış). İşletme nakit akışı 4,07 milyar yuan. Rakamlar 29 Ekim 2026 tarihli aracı kurum notundan alındı.

en.one: It trades commodities and machinery and builds ships, generators and garden equipment. A many-armed, thin-margin business; it did not meet the moat criterion.
en.business: The company has two arms. The supply chain arm trades commodities and imports and exports machinery. The industrial arm builds and operates ships and makes diesel generators, garden equipment, solar panels, environmental plants and textiles. In 2025 revenue was about 117.8 billion yuan and net profit attributable to the parent about 1.36 billion yuan; 76% of pre-tax profit came from the industrial arm.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. Most of the business is trading, and in trading the market sets the price. In the first nine months of 2026 gross margin was 6.50% and net margin attributable to the parent was 1.13%. In shipbuilding, work is won order by order and is cyclical; still, the backlog of 105 ships gives deliveries through 2030 and shipbuilding gross margin was 22.4% in the first half of 2026. Real return on equity is high: 22.42% in 2025 and 21.43% over the last 12 months. But this ratio does not show lasting pricing power: in the first nine months 61.5% of net profit went to minority interests. With a B score of 1 the company did not pass the 3rd wall.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is state-owned SINOMACH (China National Machinery Industry Corporation), with 41.60%. A cash dividend of 0.415 yuan a share, about 542.3 million yuan in total, was proposed from 2025 profit; that is 40% of profit attributable to the parent. Most of the profit stays with minority owners in the subsidiaries. The subsidiary Lanke Gaoxin bought 51% of China Air Separation in July 2026.
en.latest: 30 September 2026: In the first nine months revenue was 103.70 billion yuan, up 17.3%. Net profit attributable to the parent was 1.17 billion yuan, up 5.2%. Pre-tax profit was 3.98 billion yuan, up 15.6%; the gap came from the tax rate rising from 17.5% to 23.7% and a larger minority share. In the third quarter revenue was 37.28 billion yuan (up 14.2%) and net profit 477 million yuan (up 1.0%). Operating cash flow was 4.07 billion yuan. Figures are from a broker note dated 29 October 2026.

601838.one: Chengdu'nun şehir bankası; hendek dar, ölçütü geçti. Ancak kâr artışı yavaşladı, karşılık gideri hızla büyüdü ve reel özsermaye kârlılığı düşüyor.
601838.business: Bank of Chengdu, Çin'in Chengdu şehrinde kurulu bir ticari bankadır. Mevduat toplar, kredi verir; gelirinin çoğu faizden gelir. 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında 19,51 milyar yuan gelirin 17,91 milyar yuanı net faiz geliriydi. Eylül 2026 sonunda varlıkları yaklaşık 1,50 trilyon yuan, mevduatı 1,07 trilyon yuan, kredileri 897,9 milyar yuandı.
601838.moat_text: Hendek dar. Banka lisansı, 1,07 trilyon yuanlık mevduat tabanı ve şehrin yatırım şirketinin en büyük ortak olması gerçek bir üstünlük sağlıyor. Kanıt rakamlarda: takipteki kredi oranı %0,68, karşılık oranı %448,06. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yıldır %13 ile %18 arasında. Zayıf yanı: iş tek bir şehre ve bölgeye bağlı. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı 2023'teki %17,87'den son 12 ayda %12,52'ye indi. Yakın izlemedeki krediler yıl başındaki 2,93 milyar yuandan 4,49 milyar yuana çıktı.
601838.mgmt: En büyük ortak Chengdu'nun finans holdingi Jiaozi Financial Holdings'tir (%19,999). İkinci ortak Hong Leong Bank'tır (%17,779). Hâkim tek ortak yok, ama belediye sermayesinin ağırlığı büyük. Banka 2026'da ilk kez ara temettü verdi: 10 hisseye 4,89 yuan, toplam 2,07 milyar yuan, ilk yarı kârının %30,02'si. Son üç yılda dağıtım oranı en az %30 oldu. Kalan kâr sermayede kalıyor, çünkü çekirdek sermaye oranı %8,85 ile yüksek değil.
601838.latest: 28 Ekim 2026: Banka dokuz aylık sonuçlarını açıkladı. Gelir %9,84 artışla 19,51 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı %4,48 artışla 9,92 milyar yuan oldu. Üçüncü çeyrekte gelir %22,59 arttı, ama faaliyet kârı %0,72 geriledi. Kredi değer düşüklüğü gideri %82,52 artarak 3,30 milyar yuana çıktı. Takipteki kredi oranı %0,68'de kaldı. Çekirdek sermaye oranı %8,85, toplam sermaye yeterliliği %13,57.
risks: Güvenlik marjını zayıflatan gelişme şu: kâr artışı %4,48'e indi, üçüncü çeyrekte faaliyet kârı geriledi ve reel özsermaye kârlılığı son 12 ayda %12,52'ye düştü.
Karşılık gideri dokuz ayda %82,52 arttı ve yakın izlemedeki krediler 4,49 milyar yuana çıktı; kredi kalitesi bozulursa kâr daha da düşer.
Banka tek bir şehre ve bölgeye bağlıdır; Chengdu ekonomisinde ya da yerel kamu borçlarında bir sorun doğrudan bilançoya yansır.
Çekirdek sermaye oranı %8,85'tir; büyüme sürerse sermaye artırımı gerekebilir ve mevcut ortakların payı sulanır.
Kredi büyümesi %5,83 ile son beş yılın aynı dönemlerinin en düşüğüdür; faiz marjı daralırsa gelir artışı sürmeyebilir.

en.one: Chengdu's city bank; the moat is narrow and it meets the criterion. But profit growth has slowed, provisions are rising fast and real return on equity is falling.
en.business: Bank of Chengdu is a commercial bank based in the Chinese city of Chengdu. It takes deposits and makes loans; most of its income is interest. In the first nine months of 2026, 17.91 billion yuan of its 19.51 billion yuan revenue was net interest income. At the end of September 2026 it had about 1.50 trillion yuan of assets, 1.07 trillion yuan of deposits and 897.9 billion yuan of loans.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The banking licence, a deposit base of 1.07 trillion yuan and the city's investment company as largest shareholder give a real edge. The numbers show it: the bad-loan ratio is 0.68% and provision coverage is 448.06%. Real return on equity has stayed between 13% and 18% for five years. The weak side: the business depends on one city and region. Real return on equity fell from 17.87% in 2023 to 12.52% over the last twelve months. Special-mention loans rose from 2.93 billion yuan at the start of the year to 4.49 billion yuan.
en.mgmt: The largest shareholder is Jiaozi Financial Holdings, Chengdu's financial holding company (19.999%). The second is Hong Leong Bank (17.779%). No single shareholder has control, but municipal capital carries great weight. In 2026 the bank paid its first interim dividend: 4.89 yuan per 10 shares, 2.07 billion yuan in total, 30.02% of first-half profit. The payout ratio has been at least 30% for the last three years. The rest of the profit stays in capital, because the core capital ratio is not high at 8.85%.
en.latest: 28 October 2026: The bank reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 9.84% to 19.51 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 4.48% to 9.92 billion yuan. In the third quarter revenue rose 22.59%, but operating profit fell 0.72%. Credit impairment charges rose 82.52% to 3.30 billion yuan. The bad-loan ratio stayed at 0.68%. The core tier 1 ratio is 8.85% and the total capital ratio is 13.57%.
risks: What weakens the margin of safety: profit growth slowed to 4.48%, operating profit fell in the third quarter and real return on equity dropped to 12.52% over the last twelve months.
Impairment charges rose 82.52% in nine months and special-mention loans climbed to 4.49 billion yuan; if credit quality worsens, profit falls further.
The bank depends on one city and region; trouble in Chengdu's economy or in local public debt would show up directly on its balance sheet.
The core tier 1 ratio is 8.85%; if growth continues a capital raise may be needed, diluting existing shareholders.
Loan growth of 5.83% is the lowest for this period in five years; if the interest margin narrows, revenue growth may not last.

000333.one: Çin'in büyük ev aletleri üreticisi. Hendek dar, kalite surlarını geçti; fiyat yetmediği için kapıda bekliyor. Son çeyrekte satış ve ana iş kârı geriledi.
000333.business: Midea klima, buzdolabı, çamaşır makinesi ve küçük ev aletleri üretir; ayrıca bina iklimlendirme sistemleri, sanayi robotları ve sanayi parçaları satar. 2025'te 458,5 milyar yuan gelirin 299,9 milyar yuanı ev aletlerinden geldi. Gelirin %42,7'si Çin dışından. Para, ürettiği cihazların ve sistemlerin satışından kazanılır.
000333.moat_text: Hendek dar. Kaynağı ölçek, marka ve ürün çeşitliliği: 2025'te brüt kâr marjı %26,2 oldu ve reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yıldır %18 ile %21 arasında, son 12 ayda %19,3. Bu istikrar, tek ürüne bağlı rakiplerde yok. Zayıf yanı: ev aletlerinde rekabet serttir ve fiyatlama gücü sınırlıdır. 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde gelir %4,12 düştü, brüt marj 0,47 puan geriledi. Bu yüzden hendek geniş sayılmadı.
000333.mgmt: En büyük ortak, Midea Holding'in de içinde olduğu gruptur; en büyük ortağın payı 31 Mart 2026'da %28,53'tü. Kâr hissedara dönüyor: 2025 için hisse başına 3,8 yuan yıl sonu temettüsü (yaklaşık 28,6 milyar yuan) ve 0,5 yuan ara temettü; 2026 ara temettüsü de hisse başına 0,5 yuan. 2026'da 13,3 milyar yuanlık hisse geri alındı; bunun 11,8 milyar yuanı iptal edilmek üzere. Şirket net nakitte (net borç/FAVÖK eksi 0,99). Satın almalar ana işe yakın: Avrupa'da Arbonia Climate ve TEKA. Dikkat edilecek nokta: 2026 kârının bir bölümü ana işten değil, bellek yongası üreticisi CXMT'deki payın değer artışından geldi.
000333.latest: 29 Ekim 2026: Şirket dokuz aylık sonuçlarını açıkladı. Gelir %1,19 artışla 367,36 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı %9,27 artışla 41,39 milyar yuan oldu. Tek seferlik kalemler hariç net kâr ise %22,49 düşerek 28,79 milyar yuana indi. Üçüncü çeyrekte gelir %4,12 düşüşle 107,32 milyar yuan, net kâr %25,93 artışla 14,95 milyar yuan; tek seferlik kalemler hariç net kâr %15,70 düşüşle 9,19 milyar yuan. Bina teknolojileri geliri dokuz ayda %10 artışla 30,9 milyar yuan, robot ve otomasyon geliri %10 artışla 24,9 milyar yuan oldu.

Satış büyümesi durdu: 2026'nın ilk yarısında Çin içi gelir yalnız %2,1 arttı, üçüncü çeyrekte toplam gelir %4,12 düştü.

Gelirin %42,7'si yurt dışından geliyor; kur hareketleri, gümrük vergileri ve ticaret kısıtları kârı etkiler.
Sanayi teknolojileri geliri dokuz ayda %13 düştü; ev aleti dışı kolların büyümesi kesin değil.

en.one: China's large home appliance maker. Narrow moat; it passed the quality walls and waits at the gate on price. Core profit fell last quarter.
en.business: Midea makes air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines and small appliances; it also sells building climate systems, industrial robots and industrial components. In 2025, 299.9 billion yuan of its 458.5 billion yuan revenue came from home appliances. 42.7% of revenue comes from outside China. It earns money by selling the appliances and systems it makes.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. It comes from scale, brand and product range: gross margin was 26.2% in 2025 and real return on equity has been between 18% and 21% for five years, 19.3% over the last twelve months. Rivals that depend on one product do not have this stability. The weak side: competition in home appliances is fierce and pricing power is limited. In the third quarter of 2026 revenue fell 4.12% and gross margin slipped 0.47 points. That is why the moat is not rated wide.
en.mgmt: The largest shareholder is the group that includes Midea Holding; the largest shareholder's stake was 28.53% on 31 March 2026. Profit returns to shareholders: a final dividend of 3.8 yuan per share for 2025 (about 28.6 billion yuan) plus a 0.5 yuan interim dividend; the 2026 interim dividend is also 0.5 yuan per share. Shares worth 13.3 billion yuan were bought back in 2026, of which 11.8 billion yuan is for cancellation. The company holds net cash (net debt/EBITDA minus 0.99). Acquisitions are close to the core business: Arbonia Climate and TEKA in Europe. A point to note: part of 2026 profit came not from the core business but from the rise in value of a stake in memory chip maker CXMT.
en.latest: 29 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 1.19% to 367.36 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 9.27% to 41.39 billion yuan. Net profit excluding one-off items, however, fell 22.49% to 28.79 billion yuan. In the third quarter revenue fell 4.12% to 107.32 billion yuan and net profit rose 25.93% to 14.95 billion yuan; net profit excluding one-off items fell 15.70% to 9.19 billion yuan. The gap comes from a valuation gain tied to the listing of CXMT; that gain was 5.47 billion yuan higher than a year earlier in the third quarter. Building technologies revenue rose 10% to 30.9 billion yuan in nine months and robotics and automation revenue rose 10% to 24.9 billion yuan.
risks: Reported profit looks better than core profit: in nine months net profit rose 9.27% while net profit excluding one-off items fell 22.49%. The gap comes from the rise in value of an investment and may not recur.
Sales growth has stalled: revenue in China rose only 2.1% in the first half of 2026, and total revenue fell 4.12% in the third quarter.
Competition is fierce; price cuts erode the margin. Gross margin slipped 0.41 points in nine months.
42.7% of revenue comes from abroad; currency moves, tariffs and trade restrictions affect profit.
Industrial technology revenue fell 13% in nine months; growth outside home appliances is not assured.

Şirket 2010'daki halka arzdan beri sermaye artırmadı. Net borcu yok (net borç/FAVÖK eksi 1,37). Alacaklar azalıyor: alacak ve senetler 2025'te 7,77 milyar yuan düştü.

en.one: Maker of security cameras and video systems. Narrow moat; it passed the quality walls, waits at the gate on price. Western bans are a risk.
en.business: Hikvision makes security cameras, recorders and the software that runs them; it sells to public bodies, to enterprises and, through dealers, to small businesses. Its newer lines include warehouse robots, thermal cameras, smart home products and automotive electronics. In 2025 revenue was 92.51 billion yuan and net profit 14.20 billion yuan. 29.42% of revenue came from the overseas core business and 27.51% from the newer lines.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. It comes from scale, from selling software together with hardware and from a wide sales network. The proof is in the margin: gross margin was between 42% and 46% in 2020-2025 and 49.05% in the third quarter of 2026. That is a high level for a hardware maker. The company spends 12.70% of revenue on research and development (11.75 billion yuan in 2025). The weak side: the advantage is being tested. Revenue stood still in 2025 (up 0.01%). The United States put the company on its trade blacklist in 2019 and Canada ordered it to close its business there in 2025; some markets are closing. Real return on equity fell from 27.35% in 2021 to 15.46% in 2024 and recovered to 21.31% over the last twelve months. That is why the moat is not rated wide.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is state-owned China Electronics Technology HIK Group; its stake was 36.93% according to a June 2025 report. Most of the profit returns to shareholders: total cash dividends for 2025 were about 10.54 billion yuan, 74.25% of net profit. The 2026 interim dividend is 5.5 yuan per 10 shares, 5.04 billion yuan in total. The company has not raised equity since its 2010 listing. It has no net debt (net debt/EBITDA minus 1.37). Receivables are falling: receivables and notes fell 7.77 billion yuan in 2025.
en.latest: 16 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 12.60% to 74.04 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 38.55% to 12.91 billion yuan. In the third quarter revenue rose 13.71% to 27.22 billion yuan and net profit rose 36.97% to 5.02 billion yuan; gross margin was 49.05%. Expenses grew 4.62%, less than revenue. In July the company had said it expected 2026 revenue to exceed 100 billion yuan.
risks: Price: on the conservative calculation the share is above fair value; there is no margin of safety.

Sanctions: the United States put the company on its trade blacklist in 2019 and Canada ordered it to close its business there in June 2025. If other countries take similar steps, overseas revenue (29.42% in 2025) shrinks and sourcing parts gets harder.
Dependence on public and enterprise spending in China: domestic core revenue rose only 4.98% in the first half of 2026.
The rise in margin may not last: gross margin was in the 42-46% range for many years, and prices of memory and electronic components are rising.
A stronger yuan reduces overseas profit: a currency loss of 326 million yuan was booked in the first quarter of 2026.

en.one: Contract manufacturer of parts and devices for phones, earphones, data centres and cars. Thin margins, rising debt; it did not pass.
en.business: Luxshare makes connectors, cables and modules for other brands and assembles devices such as phones and earphones. In the first half of 2026, 122.48 billion yuan of its 174.50 billion yuan revenue came from consumer electronics, 32.39 billion yuan from automotive electronics and 16.61 billion yuan from communications and data centre products. It earns a thin slice of a large production volume: gross margin was 11.9% in 2025.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. There is an advantage: scale, precision manufacturing skill and long relationships with large customers. But this is contract manufacturing; the design and the brand belong to the customer, and the customer sets the price. The margin shows it: gross margin was 11.78% in the first half of 2026 and 10.25% in consumer electronics. In nine months net profit attributable to shareholders was 13.06 billion yuan on revenue of 285.01 billion yuan, about 4.6%. Revenue rose 29.01% while profit rose 13.36%: growth is pulling profitability down. Real return on equity stayed between 17.91% and 19.26% for five years and then fell to 15.55% over the last twelve months. With a B score of 1, the company did not pass Wall 3.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is Luxshare Limited (37.32%). The board is chaired by Wang Laichun. Most of the profit stays in the company: the payout ratio is 21.88% and the dividend yield 0.27%. Dividends were paid three times in 2026, 1.77 billion yuan in total; about 1 billion yuan was spent on buybacks. The money goes to growth and acquisitions: German automotive cable maker Leoni and Wingtech's contract design (ODM) assets. Debt is high: the debt-to-asset ratio was 67.44% in June 2026 and net debt/EBITDA is 2.23. Finance costs were 3.22 billion yuan in nine months. Operating cash flow was minus 2.45 billion yuan in the first half of 2026.
en.latest: 29 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 29.01% to 285.01 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 13.36% to 13.06 billion yuan; this is below the 13.25-14.40 billion yuan range the company estimated in August. In the third quarter revenue rose 14.62% to 110.51 billion yuan and net profit rose 6.98% to 5.21 billion yuan. The company expects net profit of 19.09-19.92 billion yuan for 2026 (up 15-20%).
risks: About 70% of revenue comes from consumer electronics and depends on a small number of large customers; if a customer moves orders to another manufacturer, profit falls directly.

The margin is thin (nine-month net profit is about 4.6% of revenue); higher costs or currency losses erode profit quickly. A currency loss of about 1.99 billion yuan was booked in the first half of 2026.
Debt is rising: at 2.23, net debt/EBITDA is approaching the Wall 2 threshold (3.0); free cash flow is negative over the last twelve months.
It is not certain that large acquisitions such as Leoni and the Wingtech assets will deliver the expected profit.
Tariffs and trade restrictions can change where production takes place and what it costs.

en.one: The world's largest electric vehicle battery maker. Narrow moat; it passed the quality walls and waits at the gate on price. Margins are shrinking.
en.business: CATL makes lithium batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage plants and sells them to carmakers and energy companies. In 2025, 74.7% of its 423.7 billion yuan revenue came from vehicle batteries and 14.7% from energy storage batteries; 30.6% of revenue came from abroad. Net profit in 2025 was 72.2 billion yuan. The company sold 661 GWh of batteries in 2025.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The advantage comes from scale and cost and shows in the figures: the company has been first in the world vehicle battery market for nine years, with a 39.4% share in the first eight months of 2026 (second-placed BYD has 15.1%). In 2025 capacity utilisation was 96.9% and research spending 22.15 billion yuan. Real return on equity has not fallen below 20.3% in five years (23.5% over the last twelve months). The moat is not rated wide because pricing power is limited and is being tested now: gross margin fell from 25.31% to 22.72% over nine months and to 20.69% in the third quarter. Talks on passing the new tax burden to customers are still under way, and those customers are carmakers whose own profits are under pressure. Battery technology changes fast and earnings are sensitive to government decisions.
en.mgmt: The largest shareholder is Xiamen Ruiting, the company of founder Zeng Yuqun (22.04%); co-founder Huang Shilin holds 9.09%. The shares trade in Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Profit goes both to growth and to shareholders: a cash dividend of 69.57 yuan per 10 shares was announced for 2025, and the company has also bought back 3.30 billion yuan of shares, which will be cancelled. There is no net debt (net debt/EBITDA −1.99): on 30 September 2026 there was 369.81 billion yuan of cash against about 169 billion yuan of bank debt and bonds. A small flaw: bonds outstanding rose from 3.44 billion yuan at the start of the year to 52.74 billion yuan, inventories rose 53% and operating cash flow fell; growth needs a lot of capital.
en.latest: 20 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. In the third quarter revenue rose 58.58% to 165.22 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 14.54% to 21.25 billion yuan; profit fell 5.77% from the second quarter. Over nine months revenue rose 56.19% to 442.14 billion yuan and net profit rose 31.60% to 64.53 billion yuan. Gross margin fell to 20.69% in the third quarter, the second decline in a row. Operating cash flow fell 23.60% to 61.63 billion yuan. The company attributed the margin pressure to product mix, to the consumption tax on lithium batteries that began at 2% on 1 September 2026, and to the cut in the export VAT rebate from 9% to 6%. The next day the share fell about 12% in Shenzhen.
risks: The price leaves too little margin of safety. Because the company pays out nearly half its profit, the growth it can fund from its own profit is 11.7% a year; the calculation uses that (five-year trend 39.5%). Profit growth is slowing (14.54% in the third quarter, 31.60% over nine months) and the gross margin is shrinking.

Tax and incentive decisions: the consumption tax on lithium batteries rises to 4% on 1 September 2027 and the export VAT rebate ends entirely on 1 January 2027. The company does not yet know how much of this it can pass on to customers.
Customer pressure: the buyers are carmakers whose profits are already under pressure; they are strong in price negotiations.
Working capital: over nine months inventories rose 53.15% and receivables 47.78%, while operating cash flow fell 23.60%.
Trade barriers: 30.6% of revenue comes from abroad, where gross margin is higher (31.44% against 24.00% at home); tariffs and local production rules can reduce this profit.

en.one: Maker of Moutai, China's best-known liquor brand. Wide moat; it passed the quality walls and waits at the gate on price. Growth has stopped.
en.business: Kweichow Moutai makes and sells baijiu, the Chinese spirit. More than 86% of revenue comes from a single product, Moutai liquor; the rest is cheaper series liquors. In the first nine months of 2026 revenue was 130.97 billion yuan and net profit 64.47 billion yuan. About 56% of sales now come from direct sales, most of them through the company's own app, i-Moutai (58.56 billion yuan).
en.moat_text: The moat is wide. The advantage comes from the brand: Moutai holds an unrivalled place in China as the liquor for gifts and banquets, and the company sets its own price. The evidence is in profitability: in nine months 64.47 billion yuan of net profit was left from 130.97 billion yuan of revenue (about half of revenue), and real return on equity has not fallen below 28.7% in five years (30.3% over the last twelve months). On 18 July 2026 the company raised Moutai's contract price from 1,269 yuan to 1,369 yuan a bottle. The weak side: demand is no longer growing. In 2025 revenue and profit fell for the first time since the company listed in 2001. In the third quarter Moutai liquor revenue rose only 0.79% despite the price rise, which suggests lower volume.
en.mgmt: The company is run by state-owned Moutai Group, whose direct stake was 54.40% at the end of 2025. Most of the profit goes to dividends: total cash dividends for 2025 were 65.03 billion yuan, 79% of net profit. The 2024-2026 plan calls for paying out at least 75% of profit. In 2025 the company bought back and cancelled shares twice, and the group bought about 3 billion yuan of shares. There is no net debt (net debt/EBITDA −0.45); cash was 195.99 billion yuan on 30 September 2026. A small flaw: part of the cash is managed through the group's finance company together with deposits of group companies, which makes cash flow swing from year to year. The state owner's priorities may differ from those of minority shareholders.
en.latest: 30 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. In the third quarter revenue rose 3.08% to 40.27 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 3.78% to 19.95 billion yuan. Over nine months revenue rose 1.96% to 130.97 billion yuan and net profit fell 0.25% to 64.47 billion yuan. Direct sales rose 32.8% to 73.77 billion yuan; sales through distributors fell 21.6% to 57.12 billion yuan. Operating costs rose 22.0%, much faster than revenue. Advance payments from distributors (contract liabilities) fell from 8.01 billion yuan at the start of the year to 2.08 billion yuan.
risks: Price: the P/E is 21.9. On the conservative calculation the share is far above fair value; there is no margin of safety.

Demand is weak: in 2025 revenue fell 1.2% and net profit 4.5%; in the first nine months of 2026 net profit slipped another 0.25%. Baijiu output in China fell 12.1% in 2025 and has been falling for nine years.
The distributor channel is shrinking: sales through distributors fell 21.6% in nine months and advance payments fell 74%. This shows distributors have less money and less appetite.
One product: more than 86% of revenue comes from Moutai liquor. Sales abroad are small and fell 57.85% to 1.64 billion yuan in nine months.
Government decisions: the company is state-controlled; limits on official banquets and gift spending affect demand directly.

en.one: Giant contract manufacturer of AI servers and network equipment. Profit grows fast but net margin is about 4%; moat weak, it did not pass.
en.business: Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII) builds servers, network equipment and phone parts designed by other companies. In 2025, 602.68 billion yuan of its 902.89 billion yuan revenue came from cloud computing (servers) and 297.85 billion yuan from communication and mobile network equipment. It earns a thin slice of a very large production volume: in the first nine months of 2026 net profit attributable to shareholders was 40.38 billion yuan on revenue of 941.41 billion yuan.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. The advantage is real: scale, factories spread across Mexico and Vietnam, and established relationships with large customers in AI servers. Cloud computing revenue rose 75% in the third quarter. But this is contract manufacturing: the design and the brand belong to the customer, and the customer sets the price. The margin shows it: nine-month net profit is about 4.3% of revenue. Real return on equity was between 14.06% and 16.21% in 2021-2024; its rise to 21.09% in 2025 and 29.26% over the last twelve months is the result of the AI investment wave. It is not yet proven that this wave will last. With a B score of 1, the company did not pass Wall 3.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is Taiwan's Hon Hai (Foxconn). China Galaxy Enterprise, controlled by Hon Hai, holds 36.73% on its own; nine Hon Hai-related shareholders together hold about 84%. The free float is small. Profit returns to shareholders: total cash dividends for 2025 were 19.45 billion yuan, 55.12% of attributable net profit. Under the buyback programme started in July 2026, shares worth 1.00 billion yuan had been bought by 19 September. Net debt/EBITDA is 0.43. The weak spot is cash: because inventory grew, operating cash flow fell 78.01% to 5.24 billion yuan in 2025; it was 3.22 billion yuan in the first nine months of 2026.
en.latest: 29 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 55.88% to 941.41 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 79.55% to 40.38 billion yuan; both exceeded the whole of 2025. In the third quarter revenue rose 57.73% to 383.55 billion yuan and net profit rose 60.35% to 16.63 billion yuan. Cloud computing revenue rose 75% in the quarter and network equipment revenue rose 1.2 times. Nine-month operating cash flow was 3.22 billion yuan (minus 4.14 billion yuan a year earlier).
risks: Profit growth depends on spending on AI data centres; if large customers slow their investment, orders and profit fall together.
Net margin is about 4%; price pressure from customers or higher component costs can erode profit quickly.
Profit turns into cash slowly: operating cash flow was 3.22 billion yuan in nine months against net profit of 40.38 billion yuan.
A large part of production is in Mexico and Vietnam; tariffs and trade restrictions can affect costs and orders.
Hon Hai holds about 84% of the shares; minority shareholders have limited say.

en.one: China's large gold and copper miner. Costs are low and profit is at a record, but metal prices set the profit. It did not pass.
en.business: Zijin Mining mines gold, copper, zinc, silver and lithium and processes part of it in its own plants. In the first half of 2026, 41.7% of gross profit came from gold and 33.8% from copper. In the first nine months it produced 70.13 tonnes of gold and 815.7 thousand tonnes of copper. 49% of its assets are outside China, in 17 countries.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. The advantage is in cost and scale: in the first half of 2026 the gross margin on mined products was 69.34%; the unit cost of gold was 347.30 yuan per gram, while the bullion price in China was 1,033 yuan per gram. But gold and copper are commodities; the market sets the price, not the company. The profit growth shows it: in the first half the London gold price rose 53.0% and the copper price 38.5%; the company's nine-month revenue rose 11.51% while net profit rose 51.93%. Real return on equity was between 20% and 22% in 2021-2023 and is 35.18% over the last twelve months. Most of the difference comes from prices; if prices turn, profit turns too. With a B score of 1, the company did not pass Wall 3.
en.mgmt: A substantial shareholder is state-owned Minxi Xinghang. Part of the profit goes to dividends: 0.38 yuan per share for 2025 (10.1 billion yuan) and a 2026 interim dividend of 0.42 yuan per share (11.1 billion yuan); the payout ratio is 37.49%. A 2.50 billion yuan buyback was completed in April 2026. The rest of the profit goes to large acquisitions: about 18.26 billion yuan for 25.85% of Chifeng Gold and about 2.4 billion yuan for 72% of Gansu Northwest Gold. The company also issued 1.5 billion dollars of bonds convertible into shares. Debt is falling: the debt-to-asset ratio was 49.55% in June 2026, below 50% for the first time since 2012; net debt/EBITDA is 0.49.
en.latest: 23 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 11.51% to 283.45 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 51.93% to 57.53 billion yuan, exceeding the whole of 2025. Operating cash flow rose 61.74% to 84.33 billion yuan. Gold output rose 8% to 70.13 tonnes; copper output was 815.7 thousand tonnes. Lithium carbonate equivalent output was 79.1 thousand tonnes. On 22 October the company announced that the purchase of a 25.85% stake in Chifeng Gold was completed.
risks: Profit depends on gold and copper prices; prices rose sharply in 2026, and if they fall, profit and return on equity fall together.
49% of assets are outside China, in 17 countries; the company itself lists resource nationalism, higher mining taxes and cross-border operating risks. The inflation adjustment uses Chinese inflation.

The 2026 production plan of the Kamoa-Kakula copper mine in Congo was cut from 380-420 thousand tonnes to 290-330 thousand tonnes; the company's 2026 copper target of 1.2 million tonnes is under pressure.
The company grows through large acquisitions; mines bought at high metal prices turn out expensive if prices fall.
Interest-bearing debt was 168.01 billion yuan at the end of June 2026; the ratio is falling but the amount is large.

en.one: A large Chinese cosmetics brand; narrow moat, meets the criterion. But about 30% of last-12-month profit is a one-off gain; core profit fell 25.5%.
en.business: Proya makes skincare, make-up and hair care products and sells them under its own brands: Proya, Caitang (彩棠), Off&Relax, Yuanse Bota (原色波塔), Flower Knows (花知晓). Revenue in 2025 was 10.60 billion yuan and net profit 1.50 billion yuan; 72.64% of revenue came from the main brand. Most sales are online: in the first half of 2026, 4.04 billion yuan of its 5.37 billion yuan revenue came from its own online stores.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The brand is real: gross margin was 73.26% in 2025 and real return on equity has been above 19% for five years (32.03% in 2024, 25.25% in 2025). The main brand has ranked first in beauty in Tmall's 11 November opening sales for four years. But the edge is costly to keep and is being tested now. Selling expenses were 49.63% of revenue in 2025 and 53.22% in the first nine months of 2026; research takes about 2%. Main-brand revenue fell 7.19% in the first half of 2026 and Caitang's fell 21.93%. Net profit excluding non-recurring items fell 25.5% in nine months; net margin dropped to 3.92% in the third quarter. The 27.54% real return on equity of the last twelve months includes a one-off gain of 445 million yuan. That is why the moat is not rated wide.
en.mgmt: The founding family runs the company. Chairman Hou Junchen holds 34.53% and his wife's brother Fang Yuyou holds 15.06%; the general manager is the chairman's son, Hou Yameng. 46.2 million of Fang Yuyou's shares are pledged and frozen; according to the press the cause is a family lawsuit over a share transfer. About half of profit goes to shareholders: the 2025 dividend was 52.58% of profit, the 2026 interim dividend is 11.80 yuan per 10 shares (462 million yuan) and 129 million yuan of shares were bought back in the first half. In May 2026 the company paid 351 million yuan to raise its stake in the make-up brand Flower Knows to 51%; it paid 779 million yuan in total over two steps and 924 million yuan of goodwill came onto the balance sheet. An application for a second listing in Hong Kong is pending; if it goes ahead, the share count rises. Cash exceeds financial debt.
en.latest: 29 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 7.46% to 7.63 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 22.46% to 1.26 billion yuan. Of that profit, 445 million yuan is a one-off gain from revaluing the earlier stake when control of Flower Knows was taken. Net profit excluding non-recurring items fell 25.50% to 743 million yuan. In the third quarter revenue rose 29.76% to 2.25 billion yuan, with Flower Knows included; net profit fell 61.18% to 88 million yuan. The company blamed higher promotion spending. Operating cash flow fell 61.06% to 467 million yuan.
risks: Last-12-month profit overstates ordinary earnings: about 510 million yuan of the 1.73 billion yuan profit is non-recurring; profit excluding non-recurring items fell 25.5% in nine months and 65.2% in the third quarter. If the decline continues, the price criterion does not hold.
Selling expenses passed 53% of revenue; main-brand revenue is falling all the same. If advertising costs keep rising, the margin narrows further.
Flower Knows was bought at a valuation of 2.83 billion yuan and 924 million yuan of goodwill arose; if the brand does not deliver the expected profit, the goodwill is written off.
Most sales go through a few platforms such as Tmall and Douyin; their rules and traffic prices affect profit directly.
Most of the second-largest shareholder's shares are pledged and frozen; the Hong Kong listing can also dilute existing shareholders.

basis.tr: Hesap son 12 ayın kârına dayanır. Bu kârın içindeki tek seferlik kazançlar: Şirketin 'olağan dışı' diye ayırdığı kalemlerin son 12 aydaki net tutarı (çoğu, Flower Knows'un denetimi alınırken eski payın yeniden değerlenmesinden doğan 445,4 milyon yuanlık kazanç): son 12 ay kârının %29,5 kadarı. Net etki %29,5; kazanç bu kadar indirildi. Son 12 ayın kârı 0,70 ile çarpılarak kullanıldı.
basis.en: The calculation rests on the profit of the last 12 months. One-off gains inside that profit: Net total over the last 12 months of the items the company itself classes as non-recurring (mostly the 445.4 million yuan gain from revaluing the earlier stake when control of Flower Knows was taken): 29.5% of last-12-month profit. The net effect is 29.5%; earnings were lowered by that much. Last-12-month profit was used multiplied by 0.70.

basis.tr: Formül yılda %9,7 büyüme veriyordu. En güncel veriler (net kâr, yıllık değişim): Ocak-Eylül 2026 %−25,5 (şirketin düzeltilmiş rakamı; açıklanan %22,5); Temmuz-Eylül 2026 çeyreği %−65,2 (şirketin düzeltilmiş rakamı; açıklanan %−61,2). Düzeltme: Tek seferlik kalemler hariç net kâr (şirketin kendi 'koufei' rakamı): dokuz ayda 743,3 milyon yuan, üçüncü çeyrekte 79,0 milyon yuan. Fark, şirketin 'olağan dışı' diye ayırdığı kalemlerden geliyor; en büyüğü, Flower Knows'un denetimi alınırken eski payın yeniden değerlenmesinden doğan 445,4 milyon yuanlık kazanç. Dokuz ayda tek seferlik kalemler net 512,8 milyon yuan. En düşüğü, enflasyondan arındırılınca, %0,0 (sıfırın altı sıfır sayılır). Bu, formülün hızının yarısından az olduğu için ikisinin ortası alındı: %4,8.
basis.en: The formula gave growth of 9.7% a year. Latest figures (net profit, year on year): January-September 2026 −25.5% (the company's adjusted figure; reported 22.5%); July-September 2026 quarter −65.2% (the company's adjusted figure; reported −61.2%). Adjustment: Net profit excluding non-recurring items (the company's own figure): 743.3 million yuan in nine months, 79.0 million in the third quarter. The gap comes from the items the company itself classes as non-recurring; the largest is the 445.4 million yuan gain from revaluing the earlier stake when control of Flower Knows was taken. Non-recurring items were a net 512.8 million yuan in nine months. The lowest, after inflation, is 0.0% (below zero counts as zero). Because this is less than half the formula's rate, the midpoint of the two was used: 4.8%.
